Language: Hindi (No translation in English)

Kunal Kamra is one of India’s most fearless stand-up comedians — a satirist who’s built his career turning politics, media spin, and hyper-nationalism into some of the most-shared comedy clips online. He’s headlined sold-out rooms across India and the UK (his August 2026 London dates sold out across two venues), and he’s not shy about a punchline that lands somewhere powerful people would rather it didn’t. Now Kamra brings that same sharp, unfiltered political comedy to the United States for a multi-city tour — a rare chance for U.S. audiences to catch him perform live!
